steps: The contact publisher and existing event-audio starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one free-planar character binding and three text parameters, including an explicit other-instance UUID filter, retains every consumer binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.

A real Godot run publishes contact_started, contact_ended and contact_started from the browser-authored binding as the free-planar character meets the wall, stops requesting motion while still adjacent, retreats, and meets the wall again. There is no characterMotion declaration or vertical displacement. The payload names the other instance while the origin names self, even though both share an actor definition. The existing animation subscriber handles ended and the UUID-filtered event-audio subscriber handles started with two executed play receipts; all three languages remain readable at 390px.

The same run’s native contact names the other body and instance despite their shared actor definition. Its source action selects the exact other-body declaration, and reopening the workbench retains the event history.

Publisher, animation subscriber and audio subscriber actions open the frozen behavior document with distinct binding property identities; exact selection is checked when the runtime supplies a source range. Observation and navigation preserve the completed job and every author file after explicit Save.

limitations: Real HTTP editor and native Godot headless test; installed Tauri, Android and Bevy were not tested.

Runtime evidence covers changes in the native blockers reported by each character movement step, plus project-event delivery and executed animation/audio commands. It does not claim persistent geometric contact or grounded-state events. Headless audio receipts do not prove audible output or audio hardware.

The browser creates one ordinary publisher TXT, registers one explicit reference and adds one free-planar character binding. Existing animation/audio consumers are saved fixture scripts; no auto-binding or parameter discovery is claimed.
